List and revoke what apps were granted through the portal (screen-share tokens, devices, background, shortcuts)

Usage: lys-shell portal permissions <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list    List every app's grants
  revoke  Revoke an app's grants in a table, or one entry of it
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
